displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 11 red flashes
meaning: The main limit switch has opened and stayed open for more than five minutes. The manual says this is usually a failed blower motor or blower wheel. The control is in a hard lockout. Power has to be cycled off and on only after the problem is corrected.
diySteps: Turn the furnace off. Cycling the breaker before the blower problem is fixed only repeats the lockout
This code follows the 4 red flash limit fault when the limit stays open for more than five minutes
Technician: check the blower motor and the blower wheel
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Eleven red flashes means the limit stayed open long enough that the control treats the blower as failed.
